n: ShadowRangeCap: A number defining the maximum distance at which shadows may be cast. Lower numbers yield less shadow cascading artifacts.
s: ShadowRangeCap: A number defining the maximum distance at which shadows may be cast. Lower numbers yield less shadow cascading artifacts.
t: ShadowRangeCap：定义阴影投射最大距离的数值。较低的数值可减少阴影级联瑕疵。

n: UseOnDemandLoader: Turning this on can save ram and thus improve perforamnce situationally but will break some mods requiring long distance viewing and also increase stutter.
s: UseOnDemandLoader: Turning this on can save ram and thus improve perforamnce situationally but will break some mods requiring long distance viewing and also increase stutter.
t: UseOnDemandLoader：开启此项可节省内存，从而视情况提升性能，但会导致某些需要远距离视距的模组失效，并增加画面卡顿。

n: EnableAtmosphericExtinction: Whether to use built-in atmospheric extinction effect of lens flares. This is somewhat expensive - O(nlog(n)) on average.
s: EnableAtmosphericExtinction: Whether to use built-in atmospheric extinction effect of lens flares. This is somewhat expensive - O(nlog(n)) on average.
t: EnableAtmosphericExtinction：是否使用内置的大气镜头光晕消光效果。此项开销略高——平均复杂度为 O(nlog(n))。

n: CleanupKSCScatters: Whether or not to remove scatters that spawn on or close to the KSC. False by default. Requires scene switch to change.
s: CleanupKSCScatters: Whether or not to remove scatters that spawn on or close to the KSC. False by default. Requires scene switch to change.
t: CleanupKSCScatters：是否移除生成在 KSC 上或附近的散射物。默认值为 False。需要切换场景才能生效。

n: DisableFarAwayColliders: Fix a raycast physics bug occuring in large systems, notably resulting in wheels and landing legs falling through the ground.
s: DisableFarAwayColliders: Fix a raycast physics bug occuring in large systems, notably resulting in wheels and landing legs falling through the ground.
t: DisableFarAwayColliders：修复大型星系中出现的射线投射物理漏洞，尤其是轮子和着陆腿陷入地下的问题。
正在导出行星贴图：高度图
正在导出行星贴图：法线贴图

n: UseKopernicusAsteroidSystem: Three valid values, True, False, and Stock. True means use the old customizable Kopernicus asteroid generator with no comet support, False means don't do anything/wait for an external generator. Stock means use the internal games generator.
s: UseKopernicusAsteroidSystem: Three valid values, True, False, and Stock. True means use the old customizable Kopernicus asteroid generator with no comet support,  False means don't do anything/wait for an external generator. Stock means use the internal games generator.
t: UseKopernicusAsteroidSystem：三个有效值为 True、False 和 Stock。True 表示使用旧版可自定义且不支持彗星的 Kopernicus 小行星生成器；False 表示不执行任何操作/等待外部生成器；Stock 表示使用游戏内置生成器。

n: UseStockMohoTemplate: This uses the stock Moho template with the Mohole bug / feature.Planet packs may customize this as desired.Be aware unchecking this disables the Mohole.
s: UseStockMohoTemplate: This uses the stock Moho template with the Mohole bug / feature.Planet packs may customize this as desired.Be aware unchecking this disables the Mohole.
t: UseStockMohoTemplate：使用带有莫霍之坑（Mohole）漏洞/特性的原版莫霍（Moho）模板。天体包可按需自定义此项。请注意，取消勾选将禁用莫霍之坑。
正在导出行星贴图：颜色图

n: DisableMainMenuMunScene: Whether or not to disable the Mun main menu scene. Only uncheck this if you want that scene back.
s: DisableMainMenuMunScene: Whether or not to disable the Mun main menu scene. Only uncheck this if you want that scene back.
t: DisableMainMenuMunScene：是否禁用主菜单的坎南（Mun）场景。仅在希望恢复该场景时取消勾选。

n: SolarRefreshRate: A number defining the number of seconds between EC calculations when using the multistar cfg file. Can be used to finetune performance.
s: SolarRefreshRate: A number defining the number of seconds between EC calculations when using the multistar cfg file. Can be used to finetune performance.
t: SolarRefreshRate：定义使用多恒星配置文件（multistar cfg）时，各次电力（EC）计算之间间隔秒数的数值。可用于微调性能。

n: EnableKopernicusShadowManager: Whether or not to run the Internal Kopernicus Shadow System. True by default.
s: EnableKopernicusShadowManager: Whether or not to run the Internal Kopernicus Shadow System. True by default.
t: EnableKopernicusShadowManager：是否运行 Kopernicus 内部阴影系统。默认值为 True。

n: KSCLightsAlwaysOn: Whether or not to force the KSC Lights to always be on. Requires game restart to take effect.
s: KSCLightsAlwaysOn: Whether or not to force the KSC Lights to always be on. Requires game restart to take effect.
t: KSCLightsAlwaysOn：是否强制 KSC 灯光常亮。需要重启游戏才能生效。
